description.value: The Mexican Corner is an authentic regional Mexican restaurant and mezcal-and-tequila bar that has operated in Whistler Village for over a decade, with dishes rooted in specific Mexican regional traditions rather than a generic pan-Mexican style. Located on the first floor of the Sundial Hotel building (accessible via elevator through the hotel lobby), it features slow-braised short rib, complex Oaxacan mole, and a curated artisan mezcal list. It presents itself explicitly as a destination dining experience rather than a quick stop, making it well-suited for cyclists seeking a substantial sit-down meal after a ride.

raw_osm.description: Mexican restaurant and bar. Ask for vegan options.
raw_osm.name: The Mexican Corner

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides primary evidence. The address (12-4340 Sundial Crescent, Whistler, V8E 1G5) and phone (604-962-4450) were sourced from the website since OSM lacks both. Vegetarian and vegan options are confirmed by both OSM tags (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) and multiple website menu items (Chipotle Piña Tostada with tofu, Charred Corn and Zucchini Enchiladas). No evidence was found anywhere for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those are marked null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: OSM has no phone or address; both sourced exclusively from website.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Fr 16:30-24:00) conflict with website hours (Sun-Fri 4pm-9:30pm, Sat 12pm-10pm); OSM hours appear significantly outdated.

OSM wheelchair=no but website states 'Elevator access through the Sundial Hotel lobby', indicating upper-floor location reachable by elevator; actual in-restaurant wheelchair accessibility remains unclear from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established full-service restaurant in Whistler Village with confirmed vegan and vegetarian options and over a decade of operation; a solid Food & Drink listing for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal.
